lines: Straight words are worth more than crooked excuses. Keep them straight.
You missed the mark badly. The apology lands closer. Do not waste it.
The apology flies straighter than the harm did. That is something.
Do not notch the same mistake twice.
I hear the words. Now keep your aim away from us.
A bent shaft can be corrected if it has not split. Prove you have not split.
Fine. Let this be the shot you meant to take.
Trust is easy to miss and hard to hit again. Try carefully.
